∀ {S : Type} (laws : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.Laws S) (family : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.FamilyId) (state : S) {write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite} {step : Option Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalPolicyAdmission.PolicyStepContext} {cell : ℕ} {leaf : Minidregg.Compiler.LawLeaf}, Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.judgeWrite laws family state write step = Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.LawFault.lawDenied cell leaf) → cell = write.cellId.value ∧ ∃ s law, step = Option.some s ∧ laws.resolve state write.cellId.value s = Option.some law ∧ law.predicate.subterm leaf.path = Option.some leaf.clause ∧ leaf.clause.isLeaf = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval leaf.clause s.oldState s.newState = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval law.predicate s.oldState s.newState = Bool.false

∀ {S : Type} (laws : Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.Laws S) (family : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.FamilyId) (state : S) (write : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataWrite) (step : Option Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalPolicyAdmission.PolicyStepContext), Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.judgeWrite laws family state write step = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Kernel.ReceivingLaw.Lawful laws family state write step
